data_fields.name: map_to_widget_ratio
data_fields.donor_constant: resize = longer map side / longer widget side

data_fields.name: tile_pixel_scale
data_fields.donor_constant: stepX = widget px / map tiles; tile centre at (tile + 0.5) * stepX

best_idea: Keep one cached colour per tile, patch only the tiles a fog or ownership event changed, and rebuild in full only on a level change or after the other side's turn.
decision_why: The cache, the changed-tile patch and the click-to-recentre fit a zone minimap, but the colours must come from zone data and engine ownership, and the fog set must be the server's visible set; the donor's round() click mapping is a defect to fix, and the minimap is HUD, not a Pit feature.
acceptance: In a world zone the minimap shows unexplored tiles black and owned camps in their owner colour, and tapping a point on it moves the world camera to that tile; a client test that patches N changed tiles changes exactly those N cached cells.
